cause: Windows MIME registry caused FileResponse to serve React .js as text/plain. The preserved nosniff header correctly blocked execution, yielding a blank page.
resolution: Explicit JavaScript, CSS, JSON and SVG media types for product assets; keep nosniff and add a browser-asset regression assertion.
prior_http_scope_limit: The real HTTP account/model/knowledge checks passed, but a successful /chat HTML response alone did not verify browser rendering.
